messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of “most important” Automotive signaling test capabilities, but they most strongly support **NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling, IMS voice/data over 4G/5G, PSAP simulation, fallback scenarios, GNSS/MSD validation, and speech-quality/audio testing** as the key automotive-relevant capabilities. [7][13][17]
### Automotive-relevant signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Supported product / option evidence | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS | EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies, and NG eCall is described as obligatory starting 2026-01-01 in the cited regulatory-transition context. | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 is stated as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions. | [8][7] |
| PSAP simulation for emergency-call validation | The verification scenario simulates a PSAP and validates NG eCall voice and data transmission, including compliance of implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024. | R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester was used in the verification of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality. | [7] |
| Hybrid eCall with fallback between packet-switched and circuit-switched paths | Hybrid eCall requires combining different transmission paths and protocols so that eCall reliably reaches its destination, with vehicles using IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G and falling back to classic CS eCall over 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades. | The R&S solution is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester with updated eCall options supporting EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance. | [17][13] |
| Call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning, and intelligible voice quality | Manufacturers need to validate that hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality across VoNR, VoLTE, and circuit-switched fallback scenarios. | The same source ties these needs to hybrid and NG eCall automotive emergency-call implementations. | [13] |
| VoNR, VoLTE, CS fallback, handover, and degraded-radio network scenarios | The listed hybrid eCall network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation. | These are stated as hybrid eCall testing scenarios. | [16] |
| IMS and application-layer testing for EN 17240 contexts | The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists R&S CMX-KA110 as mandatory for IMS tests from EN17240:2024, R&S CMX-KA098 as mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024, and R&S CMX-KF671B as mandatory for NGECALL E2E test scripts. | The same configuration lists R&S CMX-KA100, R&S CMX-KA180, and R&S CMX-KA401 as mandatory items in that NGeCall 4G/5G context. | [62] |
| Audio codec and end-to-end audio testing | R&S CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call, including AMR-NB, AMR-WB, and EVS, while R&S CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA measurements, and end-to-end audio delay. | These capabilities align with the cited need to provide intelligible voice quality in hybrid eCall implementations. | [2][13] |
| Multi-cell / EN 18052 hybrid eCall support | The hybrid EN18052:2025 minimum configuration lists R&S CMX-KA099 as `APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL` and R&S CMX-KF672B as `CMX-KF672B NGECALL TC EN18052`. | R&S CMX-KA099 is also stated to have completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025. | [21][35] |
| Protocol conformity / type-approval preparation for IVS | The cited certification-testing source states the solution is used for functional tests, protocol conformity tests, and type-approval of IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall. | The source says the test environment can simulate real-world mobile network conditions and emulate various network scenarios for certifications or preparation before new vehicle model market launch. | [13] |
### Broader CMX500 signaling capabilities that may be relevant but are not ranked for Automotive
| Capability | What the passages confirm | Automotive link status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| LTE / 5G NR FR1 / FR2 signaling | R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD for device testing. | The passages directly connect 4G/5G to automotive NG eCall and hybrid eCall, but they do not rank general LTE/NR signaling as an automotive priority outside those eCall contexts. | [1][7][13] |
| WLAN signaling | R&S CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO. | The passages list WLAN capability, but they do not directly tie WLAN signaling to Automotive applications. | [1] |
| OTA signaling for 5G NR, LTE, RedCap, and WLAN | MVG / R&S sources list 5G NR OTA signaling, 5G NR SA, FR1 SA, EN-DC, RedCap, LTE FDD/TDD signaling, and full WLAN access point and station testing including Wi‑Fi 7. | These passages describe OTA signaling workflows, but they do not directly state Automotive as the application. | [25][27][70] |
| V2X | Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF is described as an automotive-grade platform supporting high-speed connectivity, advanced positioning, V2X, multi-band GNSS navigation, and enhanced safety. | The passages do not identify a specific R&S V2X signaling test capability or option. | [10] |
### Limitations
The NG eCall EN 17240 verification source does not provide test case IDs, test conditions, network parameters, IMS setup, GNSS setup, software versions, or pass/fail details. [9]
The hybrid / NG eCall certification source does not provide a certification report number, certificate number, test dates, full acceptance criteria, full PSAP scenario IDs, or pass/fail details. [14]
The hybrid eCall page cautions that the source is not an EN 18052 or EN 17240 standards-text summary and does not prove coverage of all possible hybrid eCall test cases. [61]

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of “most important” Automotive signaling test capabilities, but they most strongly support **NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling, IMS voice/data over 4G/5G, PSAP simulation, fallback scenarios, GNSS/MSD validation, and speech-quality/audio testing** as the key automotive-relevant capabilities. [7][13][17]
### Automotive-relevant signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Supported product / option evidence | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS | EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies, and NG eCall is described as obligatory starting 2026-01-01 in the cited regulatory-transition context. | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 is stated as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions. | [8][7] |
| PSAP simulation for emergency-call validation | The verification scenario simulates a PSAP and validates NG eCall voice and data transmission, including compliance of implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024. | R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester was used in the verification of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality. | [7] |
| Hybrid eCall with fallback between packet-switched and circuit-switched paths | Hybrid eCall requires combining different transmission paths and protocols so that eCall reliably reaches its destination, with vehicles using IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G and falling back to classic CS eCall over 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades. | The R&S solution is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester with updated eCall options supporting EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance. | [17][13] |
| Call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning, and intelligible voice quality | Manufacturers need to validate that hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality across VoNR, VoLTE, and circuit-switched fallback scenarios. | The same source ties these needs to hybrid and NG eCall automotive emergency-call implementations. | [13] |
| VoNR, VoLTE, CS fallback, handover, and degraded-radio network scenarios | The listed hybrid eCall network scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation, and various network scenario emulation. | These are stated as hybrid eCall testing scenarios. | [16] |
| IMS and application-layer testing for EN 17240 contexts | The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists R&S CMX-KA110 as mandatory for IMS tests from EN17240:2024, R&S CMX-KA098 as mandatory for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024, and R&S CMX-KF671B as mandatory for NGECALL E2E test scripts. | The same configuration lists R&S CMX-KA100, R&S CMX-KA180, and R&S CMX-KA401 as mandatory items in that NGeCall 4G/5G context. | [62] |
| Audio codec and end-to-end audio testing | R&S CMX-KA180 provides audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call, including AMR-NB, AMR-WB, and EVS, while R&S CMX-KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA measurements, and end-to-end audio delay. | These capabilities align with the cited need to provide intelligible voice quality in hybrid eCall implementations. | [2][13] |
| Multi-cell / EN 18052 hybrid eCall support | The hybrid EN18052:2025 minimum configuration lists R&S CMX-KA099 as `APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL` and R&S CMX-KF672B as `CMX-KF672B NGECALL TC EN18052`. | R&S CMX-KA099 is also stated to have completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025. | [21][35] |
| Protocol conformity / type-approval preparation for IVS | The cited certification-testing source states the solution is used for functional tests, protocol conformity tests, and type-approval of IVS implementing hybrid eCall and NG eCall. | The source says the test environment can simulate real-world mobile network conditions and emulate various network scenarios for certifications or preparation before new vehicle model market launch. | [13] |
### Broader CMX500 signaling capabilities that may be relevant but are not ranked for Automotive
| Capability | What the passages confirm | Automotive link status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| LTE / 5G NR FR1 / FR2 signaling | R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD for device testing. | The passages directly connect 4G/5G to automotive NG eCall and hybrid eCall, but they do not rank general LTE/NR signaling as an automotive priority outside those eCall contexts. | [1][7][13] |
| WLAN signaling | R&S CMX500 provides WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements covering 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn, and 2x2 MIMO. | The passages list WLAN capability, but they do not directly tie WLAN signaling to Automotive applications. | [1] |
| OTA signaling for 5G NR, LTE, RedCap, and WLAN | MVG / R&S sources list 5G NR OTA signaling, 5G NR SA, FR1 SA, EN-DC, RedCap, LTE FDD/TDD signaling, and full WLAN access point and station testing including Wi‑Fi 7. | These passages describe OTA signaling workflows, but they do not directly state Automotive as the application. | [25][27][70] |
| V2X | Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF is described as an automotive-grade platform supporting high-speed connectivity, advanced positioning, V2X, multi-band GNSS navigation, and enhanced safety. | The passages do not identify a specific R&S V2X signaling test capability or option. | [10] |
### Limitations
The NG eCall EN 17240 verification source does not provide test case IDs, test conditions, network parameters, IMS setup, GNSS setup, software versions, or pass/fail details. [9]
The hybrid / NG eCall certification source does not provide a certification report number, certificate number, test dates, full acceptance criteria, full PSAP scenario IDs, or pass/fail details. [14]
The hybrid eCall page cautions that the source is not an EN 18052 or EN 17240 standards-text summary and does not prove coverage of all possible hybrid eCall test cases. [61]

answer.question: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

passages.text:
R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。
- 來源未列 test case IDs、test conditions、network parameters、IMS setup、GNSS setup、software versions 或 pass/fail details。
- 來源未說 whether verification equals formal certification；因此本頁使用 verification，不改寫為 certification。
- 來源未提供 European Commission regulation 的正式文件編號；2026-01-01 obligation date 只能追溯到本新聞稿說法。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of “most important” Automotive signaling test capabilities, but they most strongly support **NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling, IMS voice/data over 4G/5G, PSAP simulation, fallback scenarios, GNSS/MSD validation, and speech-quality/audio testing** as the key automotive-relevant capabilities. [7][13][17]
### Automotive-relevant signaling test capabilities
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Supported product / option evidence | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G IMS | EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies, and NG eCall is described as obligatory starting 2026-01-01 in the cited regulatory-transition context. | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 is stated as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions. | [8][7] |
| PSAP simulation for emergency-call validation | The verification scenario simulates a PSAP and validates NG eCall voice and data transmission, including compliance of implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024. | R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester was used in the verification of Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality. | [7] |
| Hybrid eCall with fallback between packet-switched and circuit-switched paths | Hybrid eCall requires combining different transmission paths and protocols so that eCall reliably reaches its destination, with vehicles using IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G and falling back to classic CS eCall over 2G/3G when coverage or service quality degrades. | The R&S solution is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester with updated eCall options supporting EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance. | [17][13] |
| Call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning, and intelligible voice quality | Manufacturers need to validate that hybrid implementations can trigger calls, transmit MSD, maintain GNSS positioning, and provide intelligible voice quality across VoNR, VoLTE, and circuit-switched fallback scenarios. | The same source ties these needs to hybrid and NG eCall automotive emergency-call implementations. | [13] |

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio

- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
